SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.I.D. REGISTER No. I.O. D. 1204 Date 28...4-30.）

Translation of a letter No.37 from the 1st District of Kiangsu Water Public Safety Bureau.

April 25, 1930.

Commissioner of Police,
British Police Force,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have to inform you that the man Chang Shao Hua, the leader of a gang of Haichow bandits who were responsible for the ransacking of Chang Yien Tseng Village, has been arrested and handed over to the Headquarters of the Bandit Suppression Commissioner for Tahu Lake and that his confederates Nylen Fu Zung et al have fled to Shanghai. Strict Steps should be taken to effect the apprehension of the criminals at large. Whilst despatching detectives Li Chun Dien etc. to Shanghai to make confidential enquiries I have to request the Commissioner to render assistance to our men, when they make a report at your Station.

Chu Yao Chun,
Inspector i/c of the District.

（批：Ack PCW 28/4）

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事侦缉处登记簿 编号 I. O. D. 1204 日期 28...4-30.）

江苏水上公安局第一区第37号来函译文。

1930年4月25日。

致：
上海
英国警察部队
警务总监

先生：

特此告知，海州匪帮头目张绍华已被逮捕，该匪帮曾洗劫张延增村（音译），现张绍华已被移交给太湖剿匪专员总部。其同伙倪连福宗（音译）等人已逃往上海。应采取严厉措施，以缉拿在逃罪犯。与此同时，我已派遣李春典（音译）等侦探前往上海进行秘密调查，恳请总监在我方人员向贵局报到时予以协助。

朱耀春，
该区区长。

（批注：Ack PCW 28/4）
